📅 **Exam Schedule 2024-25:**

**Semester 1 (Mid-term):** October 15–22, 2024
**Semester 1 (Final):** December 10–20, 2024
**Semester 2 (Mid-term):** March 5–12, 2025
**Semester 2 (Final):** May 20–30, 2025

Exact timetables are posted on the college notice board and official website 2 weeks before exams. Please check your email for hall ticket details.

💰 **Fee Structure (2024-25):**

| Course | Annual Fee |
|--------|------------|
| BCA | ₹45,000 |
| BBA | ₹40,000 |
| B.Com | ₹35,000 |
| B.Sc CS | ₹50,000 |
| MCA | ₹60,000 |

**Additional Charges:**
• Exam Fee: ₹2,000/semester
• Library: ₹1,500/year
• Development: ₹3,000/year

📌 Fees can be paid online via the student portal or at the finance office. Scholarships are available for eligible students.

🎓 **Admission Process:**

**Eligibility:**
• UG Courses: 10+2 with minimum 50% marks
• PG Courses: Relevant UG degree with 55% marks

**Steps to Apply:**
1. Visit the college website or office
2. Fill out the application form (online/offline)
3. Submit required documents
4. Attend counseling/interview if applicable
5. Pay admission fee to confirm seat

**Required Documents:**
• 10th & 12th marksheets
• Transfer Certificate
• Passport photos (4)
• Aadhar card copy

📅 **Admission Open:** June 1 – July 31 (for academic year 2025-26)
📞 Contact: admissions@college.edu | 9876543210

📚 **Courses Offered:**

**Undergraduate Programs (3 Years):**
• BCA – Bachelor of Computer Applications
• BBA – Bachelor of Business Administration
• B.Com – Bachelor of Commerce
• B.Sc CS – Bachelor of Science (Computer Science)

**Postgraduate Programs (2 Years):**
• MCA – Master of Computer Applications
• MBA – Master of Business Administration
• M.Com – Master of Commerce

**Diploma Courses (1 Year):**
• Web Development
• Data Analytics
• Digital Marketing

💡 All programs are affiliated with the State University and UGC approved.

💻 **BCA – Bachelor of Computer Applications:**

**Duration:** 3 Years (6 Semesters)
**Eligibility:** 10+2 with Math/Computer Science (50%+)
**Annual Fee:** ₹45,000

**Key Subjects:**
• Programming (C, C++, Java, Python)
• Data Structures & Algorithms
• Database Management (MySQL)
• Web Development (HTML, CSS, JS)
• Computer Networks
• Software Engineering
• Artificial Intelligence (Final Year)

**Career Opportunities:**
Software Developer, Web Developer, Data Analyst, System Administrator, IT Consultant

📌 Placement assistance provided. Average package: ₹3.5–8 LPA

📖 **College Library:**

**Timings:**
• Monday–Friday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM
• Saturday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
• Sunday: Closed

**Facilities:**
• 20,000+ books and journals
• Digital library access (E-resources)
• Newspaper and magazine section
• Study hall (50 seats)
• Printing & photocopying

**Borrowing Rules:**
• Students: 3 books at a time (14 days)
• Fine: ₹2/day for late return

🔑 Library card issued during admission.

**Summer Vacation:** May 15 – June 15, 2025

📊 **Exam Results:**

**How to Check Results:**
1. Visit the college website: www.college.edu
2. Click on 'Student Portal'
3. Login with your enrollment number
4. Navigate to 'Results' section

**Result Declaration Timeline:**
• Mid-term results: Within 2 weeks of exam
• Final results: Within 4 weeks of exam

**For Revaluation:**
• Apply within 15 days of result
• Fee: ₹500/subject
• Contact the Exam Cell for form

📧 Exam queries: exams@college.edu

🎖️ **Scholarships Available:**

**Merit Scholarships:**
• Top 5% scorers: 50% fee waiver
• 75–90% marks: 25% fee waiver

**Government Schemes:**
• SC/ST Scholarship (State Govt)
• OBC Post-Matric Scholarship
• National Merit Scholarship
• Minority Scholarship

**Sports Quota:**
State/National level athletes may receive fee concessions

**How to Apply:**
1. Collect form from the scholarship cell
2. Submit with supporting documents
3. Deadline: August 31 each year

📧 scholarships@college.edu

✅ **Attendance Policy:**

**Minimum Requirement:** 75% attendance is mandatory to appear in exams.

**Calculation:** (Classes Attended / Total Classes) × 100

**Consequences of Low Attendance:**
• Below 75%: Not allowed to sit in exams
• Between 65–74%: Medical/official leave considered
• Below 65%: Detained for the semester

**How to Check Attendance:**
Login to the Student Portal → Dashboard → Attendance tab

📌 Attendance is marked biometrically and updated daily.
